page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 40 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 4.8 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. Memory performance is characterized by a high cached read bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec, which drops to 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, and a write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, and AVX-512 Vector Neural Network Instructions (VNNI), which assist in vector calculations and cryptography tasks.

In application-specific benchmarks, the instance demonstrates solid capabilities for database operations and text processing. It achieves 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a Passmark database operations score of 14249.04. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the system processes 1841.39 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model, though performance drops to 56.94 tokens per second on a medium 7B model. These characteristics make the instance highly suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and relational database workloads that do not require local NVMe storage.
